title: Carts and Checkout: Turn a Shopper's Picks into a Paid Order | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Most lost sales happen between choosing a product and paying for it. The CrestApps Carts and Checkout modules give shoppers a cart that remembers what they picked, and one guided checkout with numbered steps, a running order summary, promotion codes and your payment methods, so every purchase ends as an order you can follow.

In this video:
• Why a cart and a checkout, and how their steps fit together
• Add to cart, the mini cart and the cart page
• The Contact step: name, email and billing address
• The Shipping step: where the order goes and how
• The Payment step, a promotion code and the order confirmation
• Checkout settings: one page or a page per step, billing address, and your own fields
• Use cases: guest checkout, a short path on a phone, part payment and digital goods
